name: DS-Arena-Code
description: Data Science Arena Code benchmark for evaluating LLMs on realistic data science code generation tasks. Tests capabilities in complex data processing, analysis, and programming across popular Python libraries used in data science workflows.
reputation: A very recent, niche benchmark from the Data Science Arena line that is starting to be cited for realistic data-science code generation, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: New benchmark with limited public adoption; likely susceptible to contamination because tasks are code-generation style and may overlap with common data-science patterns.
